title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
summary_full: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.
